object: FIELD INDEX experiment progression and root identity rendering

before.experiment_state: EXPERIMENT had been deprecated but later route writers reintroduced it.
before.experiment_progression: No first-class replacement for the old EXPERIMENT query/work function.
before.index_identity: NOW, HEADS and PULSE independently rendered canonical routes, producing repeated full entries even though the manifest itself had unique href/title identities.
before.validation: Deprecated EXPERIMENT state was rejected, but live experiments were not required to declare a host/baseline/mutation/evidence gate and arbitrary non-deprecated route states could still appear.

operation: Normalize new EXPERIMENT routes into CANDIDATE / PROOF_REQUIRED and normalize poetry ACTIVE_REORIENTATION → ACTIVE.
Attach field-evolution/v0.1 contracts to seven current experimental/candidate surfaces.
Add EVOLVE as a named FIELD INDEX projection over canonical route.evolution metadata.
Fold canonical identities across fixed root readings NOW → HEADS → PULSE; explicit MAP/RECENT/EVOLVE remain lawful reprojections.

Strengthen public validation to enforce the lifecycle vocabulary, reject deprecated EXPERIMENT state, require evolution contracts on live kind=experiment routes, resolve hosts, validate generation/stage, and require the EVOLVE lens.
Document the operating law in Confluence/FIELD_EVOLUTION.

after.authority: CURRENT still owns attention; EVOLVE is a projection, not a queue or scheduler.

verification.note: GitHub connector exposes no push-associated workflow/status records for these direct commits; repository-level checks were evaluated against the committed bytes.

residue: Historical release receipts may still say EXPERIMENT because they record contemporaneous release state; current lifecycle lives in manifest/current_classification.
MAP/RECENT/EVOLVE may intentionally show a route already seen above because those are explicit alternate projections.
Evolution metadata currently selects disposition; it does not autonomously execute experiments.
next: Use EVOLVE to choose a bounded evidence gate, not to create more experiments. On RETURN, either transfer the surviving mechanism into its host or park/donor/compost it before another generation.
